release_infrastructure.risk_description: The Eros image upgrade and provisioning job touch the shared GPoint production database and the running Core/Eros services. Use only exact current-main Native First V3 Buildx/GHCR/Kamal flow, with current live per-component identity, immutable digests, DB backup/migration gates, one production concurrency lock, read-only reconciliation and runtime verification.
required_gates: exact current main SHA
required PR and main Tests
Buildx immutable GHCR images with digest/read-back
read-only component and database baseline reconciliation
production lock and protected Environment
stock Kamal health checks
Runtime Verify and public smoke
single Bot/Worker identity verification
post-apply reconciliation on any failure
release_infrastructure.backup_plan: Before any Prisma Apply, use the existing Native release-backup gate to create a fresh encrypted release backup of the active production database, verify the manifest and isolated restore against Prisma head 20261105100000_gpoint_chat_policy_and_history_fences, enforce its 26-hour freshness policy, and compare backup and live baseline. Before Eros SQLx Apply, the existing scripts/eros-native-database.py prepare mode must create an encrypted run-scoped Eros dump, read back its checksum, restore it to a disposable database, apply the exact target chain and verify the complete ledger. Never store backup data in GitHub artifacts or GHCR.
release_infrastructure.rollback_plan: Never roll back database schema or delete volumes. The Prisma change is additive (one job table and indexes). For Eros, do not assume v2.7.0 binary rollback after SQLx 86/87; only use the existing protected Eros rollback compatibility check if it proves the exact retained prior image can run against the current database. Otherwise stop, reconcile read-only, keep the database untouched and use only an owner-authorized recovery plan based on the verified encrypted backup. Apply no blind retry.
stop_conditions: current live component source/digests or database identities differ from the recorded baseline or cannot be reconciled
Prisma baseline is not exactly 23 successful migrations at the recorded head, contains unfinished rows, or is not the active API database
Eros SQLx ledger differs from versions 0,78-85 with every row successful, or any checksum/owner/cluster identity differs
required backup, isolated restore, migration rehearsal, old-image compatibility decision, image provenance, GitHub approval or health check is absent or fails
any partial/ambiguous Apply, missing runtime secret mapping, unknown route or requirement to change another service, database, secret or volume
